policy.notes: Shallow clones are compatibility references only. A competition profile and current official rule snapshot must patch and validate the final output.

sources.name: Overleaf MCM/ICM Chinese annotated template
sources.upstream_relation: Uses the mcmthesis document class; the public page is not itself a Git repository.
sources.reason: Overleaf exposes this as a copy-into-account template, not an anonymous Git clone. Keep the exact page as provenance; use the separately locked mcmthesis class clone for compatibility tests only.

sources.name: Overleaf lnumcmthesis
sources.upstream_relation: No independently verifiable public Git repository was found in the page metadata.
sources.reason: The public page can be inspected, but source export requires opening a logged-in Overleaf project. Do not substitute a different repository or claim a clone.

sources.name: Overleaf CUMCM cumcmthesis template
sources.upstream_relation: The page states that it derives from the 2021 LaTeXStudio CUMCM template; local compatibility uses the separately locked CUMCMThesis repository.
sources.reason: The exact Overleaf derivative bundles additional fonts/assets and is not an anonymous Git clone. Audit each bundled asset before redistribution.

sources.name: CUMCMThesis
sources.upstream_relation: Compatibility repository related to the tkpdcwqsphwk Overleaf derivative; not asserted byte-identical.
sources.reason: The audited upstream snapshot contains no LICENSE/COPYING file or explicit repository-wide redistribution grant. Use locally for inspection and compile compatibility only.

sources.name: mcmthesis
sources.upstream_relation: Document-class compatibility repository used by the tmzfgynjcqfc Overleaf derivative; not asserted byte-identical.
sources.reason: Redistribution or modification must preserve LPPL conditions and maintained-file status; this snapshot is not an official COMAP rule source.

sources.name: Eisvogel / pandoc-latex-template
sources.reason: Useful for build and editorial engineering patterns only. Bundled font and media assets carry their own licenses and require a separate asset audit.

sources.name: SciencePlots
sources.reason: Use as a style design reference. The local plotting kit uses its own conservative style and does not require SciencePlots at runtime.

sources.name: Scientific Visualization: Python + Matplotlib
sources.reason: Sparse local clone is locked and usable for chart-design study. Book text is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and code is BSD-3-Clause; generated figures, fonts and other assets were intentionally not restored. Keep the upstream working copy local and do not distribute it with the Skill.

sources.name: Python Graph Gallery
sources.reason: Sparse local clone is locked and usable for chart-type and layout study. Root repository license is 0BSD; keep the upstream working copy local and do not distribute the repository or copied gallery assets with the Skill.
